name: red-team-ops-mcp
description: MCP server for mobile (Android) red-team operations: APK decompilation, endpoint and API-call extraction, secret scanning, APK metadata. Pure-Python (pyjadx + androguard).

tools.name: decompile_apk
tools.description: Decompile an APK into Java source via pyjadx

tools.name: extract_endpoints
tools.description: Pull Retrofit annotations and OkHttp URL literals from a decompiled APK, grouped by class

tools.name: find_api_calls
tools.description: Group HTTP call sites by enclosing class and method

tools.name: scan_hardcoded_secrets
tools.description: Decompile an APK and regex-sweep for AWS / Firebase / api_key literals

tools.name: apk_metadata
tools.description: Parse APK metadata via androguard (package, version, permissions, exported components)
